text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging on-call SRE — multiple Stripe webhook deliveries failing and Billing sync jobs returning 5xx/429. Elevation to incident. root_ts=1792105473

sre_julia: ACK. I'm on it. Seeing bursts of 429s when our billing worker calls Stripe /v1/invoices and /v1/charges. Also webhook retry queue growing: ~2.4k stuck.

eng_mike: I can pull logs. Quick question — are we seeing signature verification failures or delivery errors?

sre_julia: Delivery errors. Stripe responses are either 429 rate_limited or 500 internal. No signature failures. Logs:
```
billing-service: POST https://api.stripe.com/v1/invoices?limit=100 -> 429 RateLimitError (x-request-id=abc123)
worker-01 billing-sync: webhook delivery to /hooks/billing -> 500 from stripe, retrying
```

support_lee: Heads-up — Support is already getting customers asking about sudden account suspensions. We have ~20 customers flagged by enforcement yesterday morning that may be false positives.

billing_ops: Confirmed. Our enforcement job ran a daily sync at 02:00 UTC and marked customers with "invoiced_unpaid" for >7 days as restricted. If Stripe API is returning stale/errors, the job may have thought invoices weren't paid.

infra_ron: Are webhooks failing inbound from Stripe to us, or are outbound calls to Stripe failing?

sre_julia: Outbound calls to Stripe API failing (our billing-worker polling and invoice lookups). Also webhook deliveries from Stripe are getting delayed, but core issue appears to be Stripe-side errors. I'm seeing degraded 5xx spike on their status page queries.

eng_mike: On our side, we should pause any automatic enforcement until we confirm data correctness. Can we flip the enforcement feature flag?

pm_ana: Agreed. Customer impact is real — premature suspensions are bad PR. We'll prepare an outbound status update once we have mitigation.

sre_julia: I'm going to pause the enforcement worker and put billing-service into read-only enforcement mode. Executing:
```bash
# feature flag API call
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood-internal/flags/billing.enforcement" -d '{"value": "off", "actor": "sre_julia"}'
```

deploy-bot: deploy requested by sre_julia: pause-billing-enforcement v2 -> starting rollback/deploy. CI check OK.

eng_mike: Also gating the scheduler: systemctl stop billing-enforcement-scheduler on prod-nodes.

sre_julia: Done. enforcement scheduler stopped on 8 nodes. Verified no new suspensions queued.

billing_ops: We're drafting rollback of the enforcement changes already applied to customers. Need a list of customer IDs suspended in the last 24h. Can you dump?

eng_mike: Pulling from audit: `select id, customer_id, suspended_at from billing_audit where action='suspend' and suspended_at > now() - interval '24 hours'` — will paste results in a sec.

eng_mike: (paste) 13 rows — sending to billing_ops in private DM (sensitive).

support_lee: I will prepare a canned message for affected customers and add to the status page. Copy: "We're investigating an issue affecting billing status updates; some customers may have been incorrectly restricted. We are pausing enforcement and will restore access promptly."

pm_ana: Please add expected ETA: 2 hours for verification and restoration.

infra_ron: Meanwhile, can we add exponential backoff and client-side caching to the billing worker so transient Stripe 5xxs don't cause false negatives?

eng_mike: Good idea. Short-term: set billing-worker to use cached invoice status fallback if Stripe API returns 5xx more than 3x in a minute. Implemented a config toggle: `BILLING_API_STRICT=false`

sre_julia: I've toggled BILLING_API_STRICT=false on prod via param store. Workers will now treat repeated 5xx as transient and consult cached DB before enacting enforcement.

billing_ops: After we restore access, we'll run a reconciliation pass to ensure only legitimately overdue customers remain suspended. Plan: re-run sync against Stripe once their API is healthy, then re-evaluate.

eng_mike: Reconciliation script queued as job: `reconcile_billing --since 2026-03-14T00:00Z --safe-restore`

incident-bot: Noting external dependency: Stripe API showing elevated error rates at https://status.stripe.com (incident 2026-03-14-stripe-api-degradation).

sre_julia: I've opened an internal incident timeline and set severity to S2 — customer-facing but mitigated. Adding on-call handoff note for night shift.

pm_ana: Drafting status page update now. Will include: what happened, who is affected (subset of customers), mitigation steps (enforcement paused, reconciliation queued), and next steps (waiting on Stripe).

support_lee: Also sending targeted emails to the 13 customers immediately affected offering temporary access reinstatement and an apology.

eng_mike: Stripe support ticket opened (TKT-487291): errors on API causing delayed invoice retrieval, suspect rate-limiting on our account. I've attached logs and x-request-ids. They replied: "We're investigating a misconfiguration in webhook router — may be related to spike in delivery volume."

infra_ron: If Stripe is rate-limiting our account, consider moving critical verification path to a cached, eventual-consistent flow for the next 24–48h. Long-term we should add a payment-provider-queue to smooth bursts.

sre_julia: For now enforcement is paused and we've stopped the scheduler. Next steps: (1) billing_ops verify customer list (2) support notify customers (3) wait for Stripe resolution (4) re-run reconcile and re-enable enforcement behind a canary.

billing_ops: Confirmed — we'll run manual verification on the 13 customers and prepare a restore plan.

eng_mike: I'll create a short-lived canary toggle so we can re-enable enforcement for a small non-customer QA org once Stripe reports healthy. `billing.enforcement.canary = ['team:internal-qa']`

pm_ana: Good. Keep me posted on timeline. We'll coordinate public comms after reconcile.

sre_julia: Handoff for night oncall @eng_mike — I'll put a playbook in the incident doc and tag you. Key things to watch: Stripe API error rate, webhook backlog count, audit entries for suspensions. If Stripe says they fixed it, do not re-enable enforcement until we observe 30m of healthy calls and run the reconcile job.

eng_mike: ACK. I'll watch the metrics and be ready to run restore.

deploy-bot: Deploy complete: pause-billing-enforcement v2 -> success (8/8 nodes).

incident-bot: Recording post-incident action items: 1) Add hysteresis to enforcement job; 2) Add alert when enforcement acts on >5 customers in 1h; 3) Implement cached fallback for billing queries; 4) Add Stripe rate-limit dashboard to ops.

sre_julia: Also add runbook step to triage third-party billing provider failures so enforcement is paused automatically if upstream error rate > 10% for 5m.

support_lee: Status page draft ready, awaiting PM approval.

pm_ana: Approved. Publish and send targeted emails.

billing_ops: Restores scheduled after manual verification. We'll confirm once done.

eng_mike: Putting a final note: we changed two runtime toggles — billing.enforcement=false (global pause) and BILLING_API_STRICT=false (treat repeated 5xx as transient). Documented in incident timeline.

sre_julia: Thanks all. Closing paging loop. I'll update the incident doc with timeline and root cause once Stripe confirms.

incident-bot: Incident updated: assigned to sre_julia for investigation and RCA. Severity S2.

sre_julia: Handoff complete to eng_mike at 1792106801 — monitoring.

eng_mike: taking over — will escalate to execs if we see more customer impact.
